pages.text: Each level of Dark Denizen reduces projectile damage by 5% on a helmet, 15% on a chestplate, 10% on leggings, and 5% on boots. These bonuses add together up to a 70% reduction.

Shields gain 8% block amount and 4% block angle per level. Blocking projectile damage has a 25% chance per shield trait level (up to 100%) to send a surviving projectile back along its incoming path. At four or more combined levels, gain continuous Regeneration II, +1.5% damage per combined level, and one additional knockback level.
